description:
The U.S. Army Contracting Command-Redstone, Operations, Services, & Training Division, plans to obtain information to serve as market research to help identify potential sources that can provide a brand name purchase of one (1) ADT286-TS-PKG-110V Multifunction Reference Thermometer Readout w/Temperature model or equivalent that will be a suitable replacement for the Hart Black Stack (20+years old) for Temperature Calibrations in comparison to Type-S thermocouples. This unit has a wide range of additional functions that will allow further use throughout the Temperature Laboratory. The ADT286-TS-PKG-110V Thermometer Readout w/Temperature shall include the following specifications or equivalent (if not brand name):

                Additel ADT286-TS-PKG—110V, Multifunction Reference Thermometer            Qty: 1

                Temperature Scanner Module

110 Voltage

This RFI will utilize NAICS Code 334513.
